children: Centrifuge has launched a tokenized feeder fund for Schroder International Selection Fund’s Emerging Markets Bond fund on Solana through its asset management affiliate, Anemoy. According to Odaily, the product uses a wrapper structure, with subscriptions and redemptions settled in USDC. The minimum investment is $100,000 for non-U.S. professional investors. Schroders manages more than $1 trillion in assets. Centrifuge has previously launched on-chain products for Apollo and New York Life using similar feeder fund structures.

title: Centrifuge Launches Tokenized Schroders Emerging Markets Bond Feeder Fund on Solana
